title: Attack on Titan
synopsis: After his hometown is destroyed and his mother is killed, young Eren Jaeger vows to cleanse the earth of the giant humanoid Titans that have brought humanity to the brink of extinction.

title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
synopsis: Two brothers search for a Philosopher's Stone after an attempt to revive their deceased mother goes wrong and leaves them physically damaged in this epic alchemical tale.

title: Death Note
synopsis: An intelligent high school student discovers a supernatural notebook that grants him the lethal ability to kill anyone whose name and face he knows.

title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba
synopsis: A family is attacked by demons and only two members survive - Tanjiro and his sister Nezuko, who is turning into a demon herself. Tanjiro sets out on a quest to avenge his family and cure his sister.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen
synopsis: A boy swallows a cursed talisman - the finger of a demon - and becomes cursed himself. He enters a shaman's school to be able to locate the demon's other body parts and exorcise himself.

title: Steins;Gate
synopsis: After discovering time travel, an eccentric university student and his colleagues must use their knowledge of sending text messages into the past to stop an evil organization and tragedy.

title: Your Name
synopsis: Two strangers find themselves linked in a bizarre way. When a connection forms, will distance and time be the only things to keep them apart in Makoto Shinkai's breathtaking visual masterpiece.

title: Spirited Away
synopsis: During her family's move to the suburbs, a sullen 10-year-old girl wanders into a world ruled by gods, witches, and spirits, and where humans are changed into beasts.

title: Hunter x Hunter
synopsis: Gon Freecss aspires to become a Hunter, an exceptional being capable of greatness. With his friends and his potential, he seeks out his father, who left him when he was younger.

title: One Piece
synopsis: Follows the adventures of Monkey D. Luffy and his pirate crew in order to find the greatest treasure ever left by the legendary Pirate, Gold Roger - the One Piece.

title: My Hero Academia
synopsis: A superhero-loving boy without any superpowers is determined to enroll in a prestigious hero academy and learn what it truly means to be a hero after inheriting All Might's power.

title: Violet Evergarden
synopsis: In the aftermath of a great war, Violet Evergarden, a young female ex-soldier, gets a job at a postal station and begins an emotional journey to understand the meaning of the words 'I love you'.

title: Vinland Saga
synopsis: Thorfinn pursues a journey with his father's killer in order to take revenge and end that life in a duel of honor, paying tribute to his father amid Danish Viking warfare.

title: Spy x Family
synopsis: A spy on an undercover mission marries an assassin and adopts a telepathic girl as part of his cover story, unaware that all three possess secret identities.

title: Chainsaw Man
synopsis: Following a betrayal, Denji is left for dead. With the assistance of his pet devil Pochita, Denji is resurrected as a chainsaw-wielding human-devil hybrid devil hunter.

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners
synopsis: A street kid trying to survive in a technology and body modification-obsessed city of the future chooses to stay alive by becoming an edgerunner - a mercenary outlaw known as a cyberpunk.

title: Mob Psycho 100
synopsis: A psychic middle school boy tries to live a normal life and keep his growing emotional reservoir from reaching 100 percent, where his immense powers explode uncontrollably.

title: Haikyuu!!
synopsis: Determined to be like the legendary player known as the 'Little Giant', a short boy named Shoyo Hinata joins his high school's volleyball club and strives for national glory with genius setter Tobio Kageyama.

title: Cowboy Bebop
synopsis: The futuristic misadventures and tragedies of an easygoing bounty hunter and his eccentric partners navigating the dangerous criminal underworld of the solar system.

title: Kaguya-sama: Love Is War
synopsis: Two elite high school students, Miyuki and Kaguya, are too proud to confess their feelings for each other, turning courtship into an all-out battle of psychological wits to make the other confess first.

title: Neon Genesis Evangelion
synopsis: A teenage boy finds himself recruited by his estranged father to pilot a giant biological mecha to protect post-apocalyptic Tokyo-3 from enigmatic monstrous entities known as Angels.

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
synopsis: An elven mage reflecting on human mortality embarks on a nostalgic pilgrimage across the continent decades after her adventuring party defeated the Demon King.

title: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion
synopsis: After receiving the power of absolute obedience from a mysterious woman, an exiled Britannian prince leads a rebellion against the tyrannical Holy Britannian Empire under the masked vigilante persona Zero.

title: Your Lie in April
synopsis: A piano prodigy who lost his ability to hear the piano notes after his mother's death finds renewed passion for life and music through a free-spirited, eccentric violinist.

title: One Punch Man
synopsis: The story of Saitama, a superhero who can defeat any opponent with a single punch but seeks to find a worthy foe after growing bored by a lack of challenge in his fight against evil.

title: Bocchi the Rock!
synopsis: An extremely introverted, socially anxious high school girl who masters the guitar joins a struggling indie rock band and gradually steps outside her comfort zone.

title: Monster
synopsis: A brilliant Japanese brain surgeon in Germany risks his career to save a critically wounded young boy, only to discover years later that the boy has grown up into a ruthless charismatic psychopath.

title: A Silent Voice
synopsis: A former elementary school bully seeks redemption by reconnecting with the deaf girl he once tormented, exploring profound themes of forgiveness, empathy, and self-acceptance.

title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War
synopsis: The peace is suddenly broken when warning sirens blare through the Soul Society. Soul Reapers face an unprecedented all-out invasion from the returning Quincy army led by Yhwach.

title: Naruto Shippuden
synopsis: Naruto Uzumaki, a hyperactive and knucklehead ninja, returns from years of training to protect the Hidden Leaf Village and save his best friend Sasuke from the clutches of darkness.
